reviews.text: We adore having Christina in our home each week. When my wife comes home from work to clean kitchen and sparking bathrooms and a shiny bedroom, she breathes a special kind of sigh. Being in the habit of picking up each week means that our house never gets too bad, or at least not for too long. Christina works hard and cares about our home. She gets along with our pets and is a great communicator. We recommend her highly!
reviews.author: Jesse Merz and Family

reviews.text:
Christina has been cleaning my house bi-monthly for almost a year now and I couldn't be more pleased! Not only does she provide a great cleaning service, she is also very kind and dow to earth, and affordable.
Moms can't do it all.  We need some downtime too!  Christina makes my life so much easier.  I cannot articulate how awesome it is to come home after a 10-14 hour day to a clean home. If you are exhausted, spread too thin, don't have enough time in the day, need a clean home to function, want to spend more time with loved ones, do yourself a favor and call Christina.
reviews.author: nic b.

reviews.text: Christina did an amazing job, she went above and beyond what we agreed on. Christina was on-time, organized and friendly. If you want an honest, reliable and hard worker look no farther. Best cleaning service in town. :)
reviews.author: P.J. Radanich

reviews.text: Christina is excellent! We worked with Christina to order a gift certificate as a housewarming gift for our friends, and Christina was so responsive and professional. Christina lives up to the great reviews of this business!
reviews.author: Anna Dearman

reviews.text: Christina & Gabby did an amazing, thorough job deep cleaning my house. They were friendly, professional, & hard working. 10/10 recommend
reviews.author: Amanda Manis
